name: Anika Rao
quote: I joined alone and never had to perform extroversion. The houseboat night was quiet, the captain actually knew the trail of logistics, and Munnar was given a whole morning instead of a selfie stop.

name: Dev Malhotra
quote: The vehicle was on time, the homestay in Kaza had hot water when it mattered, and nobody pretended the altitude was casual. I would take the same captain again.

name: Farah Qureshi
quote: I wanted the island and the night, and I also wanted to know someone was counting heads. Both things were true. The free day was a free day.

name: Kabir Sethi
quote: Leh was handled like a rest day, not a wasted day. Turtuk felt like the point of the trip rather than a brag on the brochure.
